name: ROLA-BOLA
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: ROLA-BOLA is a guy from a Circus. And not any circus. He's the third one from The Hoppy Circus Carnival which came to our city. Collab with our brother Maskeron is bringing this Double NE IPA with full & silky body and a lots of tropicals in aroma and flavour. Balancing with pineapple, vanilla and coconut notes, this beer is a real circus!

name: 5th Anniversary Beer #5 - Triple NEIPA
text: 5 BEERS FOR 5 YEARS! #5 in our 5th Anniversary Beer edition - all in at the end. One of the most popular NEIPA styles. Yes it's maybe hot for 9% and bunch of hops, but it's our birthday!

name: Fantastic Four
text: Birthday celebration special for our friends from Beer Sheep. We don't brew smoothies & pastries and we will never do ordinarly, but for friends you need to create whatever they like. Long Live Beer Sheep, the best beer shop in Belgrade!

name: Brain Blocker
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Brain Blocker je potreba da ovo vreme ucinimo laksim. Pitkoca standardne NeIpe uz ne tako naivnih 8% alk. Double NeIpa duplo hmeljena Idaho, Eldorado, Citra i Mozaic hmeljevima.

name: The Worst Beer Geek Ever
text: He's Rangel. He's our Bulgarian brother and the main and only guy behind Dogma Brewery Bulgaria project. Recently he became a gypsy brewer thru his new project Bad Manners Gypsy Brewing Co. And all of that is cool. But he is still THE WORST BEER GEEK EVER. We brewed this super juicy IPA which was triple dry hopped. We've bringing you orange. Squeeze it & enjoy!

name: Serbian Barrels Series No. 1 - Imperial Stout
text: No. 1 in our, worldwide unique barrel aging series - SERBIAN BARRELS SERIES! We're using only Serbian barrels & here we have an Imperial Stout with cardamom & cocoa nibs, aged over a year in 26 (now 27!) old Serbian Vinjak (Cognac) barrels. Prepare the senses & enjoy!

name: 02 Kolaboracija Caramel Stout
text: Caramel stout aged for 6 months in oak barrels of the famous Arkanj brandy (Calvados) made by the Kovilj Monastery. For three years in Top 50 stouts of the world. Best beer in Serbia by Ratebeer.

name: Bon Baisers De Belgrade
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: We met our Zythologist friends in Bruge. After that they came to Belgrade and here we are - sending all the love and kisses from Belgrade! Thru this super juice DIPA boosted with Citra & Talus... Enjoy our friend!

name: Juice It Up!
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Juice it up! Just juice it up! Give me more. Just give me more! This DDH DIPA got a flavour from CItra Incognito and aroma of El Dorado, Citra and Mosaic. It's juicy & and it bringht you more. Of everything!

name: Peacock #5
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Double NE IPA, sa Sabro cryo, Citra cryo i Mosaic hmeljevima u dry hopu.Ziveli!

name: Westie of the Tulips
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Westie Of The Tulips came a long way from Netherlands for our first collaboration with Dutch breweries. This beer is potent & juicy. That's just enough to tell!

name: Rigor Mortis
text: Rigor Mortis, zver koja je je svoju apsolutnu ličnost oformila u periodu od 12 meseci u Merlot/Probus buradima. Struktura dominantnog karaktera dovela je do sveobuhvatne koegzistencije složenog pivskog ukusa i egzotičnog vinskog karaktera.

name: Three Hoppy Sisters
text: Strast prema kuvanju piva ne krijemo, a traganje za novim ukusima nas je često odvelo ne samo do novog pivskog recepta već i do sjajnih saradnji sa drugim pivarama. Tako se ideja o Three hoppy sisters pivu rodila. Simbolično, Three hoppy sisters predstavlja sponu između @twohoppysisters i Zbir pivare. Smela i do sad zapravo neviđena kod nas, ova Triple Neipa satkana je od obilja ječma, pšenice i hmelja. Kremasta, balansirane gorčine sa mrvicom kiselkastih nota, Three hoppy sisters biće vam definitivno dobro društvo nakon napornog dana i dnevnih obaveza.

name: Serbian Barrels Series #7 - Imperial Quince Sour
text: Number 7 is here! An Imperial Quince Sour produced with mixed fermentation - imperial kettle sour on one & fermented quince wine on other. Those two mixed went to Serbian wine barrels and aged for six months.

name: Black Widow Kentucky Bourbon
text: Russian Imperial Stout aged 9 months in Kentucky Bourbon barrels.

name: Muma Paduri Mountain IPA
text: Muma Paduri is a myth. She's Mother of Nature which protects woods in Eastern Serbia. And it's perfect to descirbe our collaboration brew with friends from Zmajska Pivovara - this new hybrid among IPA's. Super potent, somewhere between West & East Coast, but still American IPA in all atributes!

name: 5th Anniversary Beer #4 - KVEIK NEIPA
text: 5 BEERS FOR 5 YEARS! #4 in our 5th Anniversary Beer edition - that nasty  KVEIK yeast is to blame for this juicy brew. There is also our friend Minja with his Dead Water Brewing Co. homebrew alias and his knowledge for this beer style. Cheers brother!

name: HOPE
text: Dictionary says that HOPE is a feeling of expectation and desire for a particular thing to happen. As the whole planet went to a lockdown, we decided to brew this juicy hazy IPA with loads of Sabro, El Dorado, Idaho 7 and Citra hops. And we decided with our partners from Ball Packaging to donate 100 dinars from every can and to help socially vulnerable groups in our country!

name: MANGOA
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Story about GOA island is well known all over the world. Story about MANGOA will be written by every sip of yours. Full & rich, well balanced and powerfull, this true milkshake in a beer world will make your day colorfull! Yes you'll start to fantasize about the island of GOA. Party can start with mango & milky tones fully supported by a touch of Sabro hops!

name: Peacock #4
text: Grejp, mango, breskva - ova paleta ukusa, našeg IV nastavka Paun serijala, nikad nije bila izraženija - novim hmeljevima Simcoe cryo i Citra cryo, citrusni ukusi su podignuti na najviši nivo.

name: Crasher
text: Dupli Dry Hop(DDH) uz 4 vrste američkih hmeljeva i dodatak pšenice,spelta,ovsa i ječma u kombinaciji sa tečnim verdant kvascem donose aromatičnu mutnu i nefiltriranu NEIPU pravo na vaša nepca.

name: Shake Those Melons
text: DDH Milkshake IPA with melon, a tropical bomb in your mouth.

name: High Grade
text: Friendship = Craft Brewing. Yes it is! This beer is a product of first ever brewing at the same time. Night in Belgrade &  morning in Sydney. Same recipe brewed in the same moment. Slovenian, New Zealand & Australian hops. I will just say that this beer is AMAZING! :D

name: 8th AB - Lost In A Hop Field
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: One of two brewery collabs for our 8th Anniversary. We've lost in a hop field with our brew brothers from Crow Brewery.

name: HOP SHOWER
text: Everybody likes good shower. Brewers like it like a hop shower! Super potent NEIPA with El Dorado, Simcoe, Citra & Columbus gives you orange punch on every sip.
1019 is a hop we fell in love with last year at CBC. It's just unique and cause of that we've bring it first to Serbian craft beer fans!

name: Vinje Draku Pista Garda
text: Draku is a word for devil in Romanian. This sentence is unique one and Romanians dont have it as its specific for Vlachian minority in Eastern Serbia. It means "Devil comes over the fence". This beer is not so evil - its just a Kveik NEIPA brewed with our Romanian brothers from Bereta. Kveik Voss meets Citra, Bru-1 & a bit of Sabro!

name: Ludilo
text: Milkshake IPA.Collaboration with Bottle Share (RU).

name: SARCASM
kind: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
text: Brewers are pretty sarcastic when they're saying that they like to brew NEIPA! Becayse they're "enjoying" in all operations from malt milling thru lautering to heavy double dry hopping :D Because of this we called this juicy collaboration brew SARCASM! Enjoy while you drinking. Not like brewers! :D

name: Vista Mikkeller IPA#2
text: Vista series dramatically continues, as the label story unfolds so does the new IPA style! Number two represents a powerful blend of fruit flavors,  beside its higher alcohol content. From today, let’s spice up the days, with this spectacular beer that will raise the pulse and atmosphere.

name: Coast To Coast
text: Collab with our friends from Nice. We are bringing you this Citra & Nelson Sauvin NEIPA from coast of Belgrade river Sava to coast Blue coast of France!

name: All Together
text: We're super proud to be part of All Together beer which came from our colleagues from Other Half! This NE IPA brings you smoothness & hop power of Mosaic, Citra, Comet and Enigma. We're in this ALL TOGETHER! #AllTogetherBeer

name: Alpha Dog
text: Alpha Dog -  A razor-sharp leader of the pack of wild dogs: Centennial, Citra, Galaxy, Mosaic, Sabro, Chinook, Columbus.Made out of six hops and a double dry hop for the impeccable strength, that only the brave can relate to. This Triple IPA is an adventure in a glass, that slides down like heavenly nectar and bangs like the hammer of God. No leash can hold it, and its tail wags for no one.

name: Pudding IPA
text: New England IPA sa dodatkom pudinga od vanile i mlečnog šećera.

name: Citrozaik
text: Prava žurka od piva se zakuvala u 3biru. Citrozaik je plod tropskih vibracija i letnje žege. Citra i Mozaik su dežurni krivci za fantastične arome, a blend 3 kvasca podiže igru na novi nivo. Recept iz budućnosti za pivo koje pravimo danas!

name: Serbian Barrels Series No.5 - Imperial Coffee Stout
text: Number 5 in our unique BA series where we're using ONLY Serbian barrels. This time, in 27 years old Serbian Vinjak (Cognac) barrel we've put Imperial Coffee Stout. One 500L barrel & that's it ladies & gents!

name: Shake
text: Mlečna senzacija prefinjenih aroma koja će ti promućkati glavu! Stout, lagan i pitak, punog ukusa i bogate arome najfinije mlečne čokolade, karamele, jutarnjeg kapućina, sa slatkom jagodom u završnici. Prava poslastica!

name: Hazy Alpaca
text: Our new NEIPA is double dry hoped widh Idaho 7, Eldorado, Citra and Mosaic hops in a combination with verdant yeast.

name: Black Fire
text: Skladno spremljena tinktura čokolade, kafe, suvih šljiva, porto vina sa čak 8 vrsta specijalnih sladova. Lekoviti balzam koji miluje dušu. Počastite se ovom poslasticom i spasite svet od kataklizme!

name: Black Widow
text: Black Widow is Russian Imperial Stout brewed with mix of pils, caramel malts, chocolate malt, and roast barley.

name: Lollihop
text: Zaboravite na uzdržavanje od slatkiša, Zebrew Lollihop sa svojih 7% alkohola, ekstremnom mutnoćom i neverovatnom aromom bombona, citrusa i vanile, koje potiču od hmeljeva Citra i Simcoe, čini savršeni izbor za nadolazeće vrele dane.

name: 5th Anniversary Beer #1 - Double Hoptopod
text: 5 BEERS FOR 5 YEARS! #1 in our 5th Anniversary Beer edition - yes it's Double Hoptopod, an alcohol and hops upgrade of our bestseller!

name: Dogma In Da Streets / ENDO
text: ENDO is the first Serbian street artist who came into this Dogma In Da Streets series which will bring you the best Serbian, regional & European street artists who will make ilustrations for our labels and will make our brewery walls a live! Every artist = one beer as his favourite style!

name: Mikkeller Vista Milk Stout
text: Milk Stout, smooth, full mouth feel. Strong body with distinctive flavours of coffee, cocoa, vanilla and tropical notes in the back, a real treat for the connoisseurs. Not for lactose intolerant.

name: Dip In the Dark
text: A 2024 version of our Imperial pastry milk stout with sour cherries, vanilla, cinnamon, plazma cookies and lactose.The idea was to mimic the taste of a cherry pie, but with a bit of a twist.

name: Memento Mori
text: MEMENTO MORI - Powerful stout with intense taste and wide range of aromas of Arabica coffee, raw cocoa, and dark caramel. A strong body with a silky structure of moderate bitterness will disarm you in a combination with a sweet flammable finish. By the way, did we mention that there's also OUR comic book by the same name? Darkwave Baby!

name: PROTOTYPE
text: PROTOTYPE is a strong beer.. with a strong body and a strong taste, of course and strong bitterness... a mixture of three yeasts, three types of malt and three types of hops will make you feel as if your mouth has been raped...enjoy

name: Mjölnir
text: Mjölnir je New England IPA, mutnija od Dunava, osvežavajuća i s kremom umesto pene.Lagano, a jako, ovo pivo je najmoćnije oružje u borbi protiv divova i unutrašnjih demona. Bez izuzetka pogađa metu i zatim se vraća u vaše ruke. Samo pružite čašu! SKÅL!

name: Midnight Owl / Nitro Edition
text: Yes, we like to drink this! As our Midnight owl. Super rich and roasty in aroma & flavour with creaminess from the nitro part. Be aware, as this coffee beer is "lying" you on every sip! And try it again.

name: Murder of Crows: Vanilla & Coffee
text: Collaboration with Brouwerij Bravoure from Netherland.Aged in Woodford Reserve & Wild Turkey bourbon barrels for over 10 months it's enriched with Guatemalan robusta coffee and Madagascar Vanilla.This blend is characterized by an immense thickness and complemented with flavors of toffee, sweet caramel, molasses, coffee, chocolate, vanilla, oak wood and figs. Aged it gracefully with love and patience.

name: Smoothiesh: What Is An Octopus's Favourite Food?
text: 'Pelicans are among the largest flying birds. They are famous for their huge throat pouches. A pelican uses its pouch and its very long bill to scoop up fish. name: Blackheart Queen
text: After the King, here is the Queen!Our BLACKHEART QUEEN is a big imperial pastry stout dipped with chocolate brownie!Extra thick with huge body, yet smooth and tender. Real chocolate brownie in a glass. Enjoy!This Is Why We Brew!

name: Double Imperial Chocolate Cheesecake Stout
text: Lervig (Stavanger, Norway) Collab: 12%We love making BIG Imperial Stouts and we love Lervig's too so we came together for one of our five celebratory 5th birthday collabs: Imperial + Imperial = Double Imperial Stout. The first in our new series of Double Imperial Stouts this 12% monster is packed with Cacoa, Cocoa, Vanilla Pods and yes cheesecake mix. It's strong, sweet and indulgent with 8 different malts plus loads of Oats for that great rounded mouthfeel.

name: Lusca
text: Dark, smooth, oily, massive, full-bodied imperial stout aged 13 months in Irish Whiskey Barrel.The dark depths of the ASW Fiddler Irish Whiskey cask captivated us and layered a subtle malt sweetness, hints of vanilla and a light oak aroma, balanced with notes of caramel, toffee and a delicate spicy character reminiscent of classic Irish whiskey, while retaining the depth of bourbon. Let the cask speak for itself.Lusca is sea monster from Carribean, half shark, half giant octopus with sharped teeth and deadly tentacles.Hand-waxed, brewed with passion and patience, this is liquid dessert in a glass.This is why we brew!

name: Smoothiesh: …I'm Bacon
text: What did the pig say on the warm summer's day? - I'm bacon!You didn't have to wait long for an answer from a giraffe's question. The Pig has spoken. The Pig knows things. The Pig has sense of humor. The Pig knows the answer. The Pig loves ballet. The Pig is magical. Be like Pig. Eat your smoothie. Ultra super loaded with passion fruit, apricots and pineapple, this is true soursweet healthy bomb!Be like Pig. Eat you smoothie. This is why we brew!

name: Goddess Freya
text: We are massively pleased to announce the long-awaited release of a collab beer with one of the pioneers of European modern craft brewing - the great Lervig.Together we brewed Imperial stout, what would later become 'Goddess Freya' - a smoothie cream stout, packed with milk cream, coffee from craft roastery 'Kavantura' and salted caramel. Absolutely delicious cream stout, like coffee liqueur,  with touch of salt!

name: Little Green Man
text: Damn it's green!Yup, we made fruited sour, almost like smoothie. And it's green.Heavily fruited with passion fruit, pineapple, mango and papaya, conditioned on coconut and than twisted with blue spirulina. This crazy blue algae combined with our yellow mixture of fruits gave this sour green cool looking color with some good health benefits.Tasty tropical bomb!Contains real fruit. Don't age. Keep in a refrigerator. Drink fresh. For best experience, gently rotate the can few times.This is why we brew!

name: Double Imperial Chocolate, Fruit & Nut Stout
text: SIXTH BIRTHDAY COLLAB BREWDeep, smooth and indulgent with Cacao Nibs, Raisins, Hazelnuts & AlmondsRested on Rum barrel wood chips & Vanilla pods

name: Smoothiesh: What's Forrest Gump's Password?
text: It is time for another smoothie sour, another dad's joke, just before summer time..An aligator Dan asked a question: 'What's Forrest Gump password?'The answer to this question you will find in next smoothie sour label, coming out in couple of days...We combined tradional apple pie flavours with belgian and Dutch touch ?Imagine apple pie and speculaas coockies.. Now open eyes and have a sip of this tasty smoothie sour. Yummmy!Super loaded with apples, pear and peach, hint od lemons and twisted with cinammon. Contains real fruit. Don't age. Keep in a refrigerator. Drink fresh. For best experience, gently rotate the can few times.THIS IS WHY WE BREW!

name: Fiddler's Black
text: The antipode to our Fiddler's Green, we present you Fiddler's Black!Every sailor has his own hell with his mesmerising mermaid. This is ours.Thick as hell, this luxurious imperial stout is conditioned on coffee and vanilla. Wonderfull nutty espresso taste with delicate layer of vanilla. Along with dark chocolate notes and liqueurish taste, it is a dark beauty!As a dessert beer, it's going well with chocolate cakes, dark cookies, tiramissu and other sweetish stuff.Suitable for aging.

name: Hound Cake: Cheesecake
text: Collaboration with White Dog brewery!In our new fruited pastry sour series 'Hound Cake' we  combined a new crazy pastry stuff - cheesecake.We wanted to create real cake and pie feeling in this smoothie sour.Imagine forrest fruits with cheesecake and vanilla icecream taste. Take a sip, enjoy and thank us later.GENTLY ROTATE A CAN FEW TIME BEFORE OPEN FOR BEST EXPERIENCE.Contains real fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age. Keep in refigerator. This is why we brew!

name: Smoothiesh: Rude-olph!
text: Mr. Penguin is rolling and we have to answer his question: "What do you call Santa's most impolite reindeer?"So here it is - 'Rude-olph!' is our new smoothiesh sour turbo loaded with a crazy combo of pineapple and raspberry. Sweet and sour. We really managed to achieve a candy-like taste. It throws childhood memories when we used to eat soursweet 'shock' candies who were sour inside and sweet outside so you got mouth freezed while chewing...Thick, sour, sweet, delicius and every sip crave for more, awesome!This is why we brew!Contains unfermented fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age.Gently rotate a can few times before you open it for best experience.

name: El Charro Negro
text: Another thick, oily, massive imperial stout, conditioned on coconut, caccao nibs, freshly roasted coffee and chili.Inspired by a mexican cake, it brings lot of chocolate and caramel flavours combined with coffee, coconut and with tingling feeling from chili at the end.. Awesome!Another collab beer with our friends from Netherlands - Bravoure Brouwerij

name: Prince of Darkness
text: We brewed this imperial stout as tribute to our beloved Ozzy. Thank you for all your music, enormous energy and  countless headbangs! Your voice, your lyrics will echo forever! We added bourbon barrel aged maple syrup from Vermont, and La Cabra's Tunsisa, an Ethiopian coffee beans with rich chocolate flavors and notes of brown sugar. Delicious!It's big stout, enriched with maple syrup and coffee flavors, full bodied, silky, smooth with sweetish finish. Black as our dark legend - Prince of Darkness!This is why we brew!

name: Smoothiesh: What Do You Call Santa's Most Impolite Reindeer?
text: At the end of 2021 year we bring you two new smoothiesh pastry sours, both are crazy and must try.Of course we did a new dad's joke with smoothiesh labels, as first label always asks question and second label has an answer."What do you call Santa's most impolite reindeer?" is ultra mega loaded with banana, mango and pear. It is super thick, fluffy and just delicious.Contains unfermented fruit. Drink fresh. Don't age.Gently rotate a can few times before you open it for best experience.This is why we brew!

name: I Scream: Freddy
text: This crazy smoothie definitely took us the longest time from idea and first tests to realization. It turns out that incorporating ice cream into beer is not at all easy.Thanks to a long brainstorming session by our R&D team - this sounds serious - and finally the ideal ice cream we've been looking for a long time, we've arrived to our new smoothie series - 'I scream'.The first edition is the all-time classic Freddy Krueger from 'A Nightmare on Elm Street' which brings you a generous amount of sour cherry, and banana, with a whopping amount of chocolate/hazelnut ice cream.Contains real fruit. Don't age. Keep in a refrigerator. Drink fresh. For best experience, gently rotate the can few times.THIS IS WHY WE BREW!
